cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Truth or Loyalty
cards.instruction: Make someone choose between protecting the relationship and answering a dangerous question honestly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Mum's asking who broke her vase. Will you tell her, or keep your promise to your little brother? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's blaming the cleaner. I can't let that happen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Clear the cleaner. Do you have to name me?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's asked me directly whether you did it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then are you answering her, or keeping the promise I trusted you with?

mechanism: A directs handling Mum question, concedes clearing an innocent person and offers joint presence only if B protects the sibling promise over the dangerous truth.
confusable: Unlike hiding a fact with no relationship stake, A forces loyalty versus honest answer; authority changes the plan around B conscience while depending on B backing.
comparison: A sibling promise and innocent cleaner differ from a business partnership exposed by copied work.
seedUse: D130-a vase, cleaner and direct question; S02-a accepts a revised condition while preserving the loyalty demand.
